## Cost per line-up system

Component seconds are measured (manifests, completion markers, the laptop log).
Sums per system and every USD figure are derived: laptop USD is 0 by assumption (owned laptop, energy not counted); pod USD is seconds x rate.
Query encoding on the laptop is counted in full for each system that needs it.
Pod idle, setup and transfer time are not apportioned here; the whole-pod money figures are in `plan.md`, tasks 9 and 10.
Anything with no record is written `not recorded`, never estimated.
